summary:
Reviewed 606654ee (the same change as the implementer's 4e45fc32, rebased). r171: an integrate round's glossary entries become one drafted glossary.md, committed with the round. r172: holds only because no apply route for glossary-proposals exists yet.
One test weakened: spec_integration_steps drafts_glossary_change lost its 'no glossary.md' assert. Its interim allowance holds (first committed in 085527d8, after the base; r54 does not ask for it).
Fix now (Important): supervise_rounds.py:47 skips the integrate round of a started initiative that holds only a glossary-proposal. r93's text asks for that round. Plan D3's reading is sound, but r93 needs rewording through a proposal.
Observation (Important): supervise_change.py:132-138 always overwrites glossary.md, so a second integrate round naming the glossary would lose an existing proposal's status and Q&A. Minor: a capability named 'glossary' would collide with it; 2 new ruff findings in new steps.
tools size clean; vulture clean; features/ untouched.
